profile.move: Six phases of a compact four-legged trot: alternating diagonal paw pairs, knees and paws actually change, tail and cloud mane follow. No locomotion smear.
profile.attack: Ready low shoulders / draw head back and open jaw / coil hindlegs / short forward bite with extended neck / forepaws land and jaw shuts / return to ready. Neutral skull, no giant open-mouth head.
profile.death: Standing struck / legs buckle / roll to near side / lie on side / still corpse / final settled corpse, paws slack and eyes shut. Keep head-body scale.

profile.move: Six phases of roots shuffling in sequence, torso sways gently and leaves lag, no human stride.
profile.attack: Roots planted / branch arms rise / leaves brace and seal arm aims / branch points forward to release ray (NO ray drawn) / branches recoil / root and branches return.
profile.death: Seal branch droops / roots buckle / trunk pitches / broken trunk rests / leaves wither / settled root-and-wood corpse. No explosion.

profile.move: Six phases of a low six-legged scuttle, alternating tripods, shell stays same volume, pincers bob slightly.
profile.attack: Ready closed shell / front plate braces / pincers draw in / short thrust forward with pincers / brake with feet apart / closed shell recover.
profile.death: Shell shudders / legs buckle / tilts near side / overturned shell / legs curl inward / settled overturned shell. No new anatomy.

profile.move: Six wingbeat phases: wings up / diagonal down / extended flat / downstroke / folded recovery / rising wings. Torso and face remain same size, hover ground root separate.
profile.attack: Neutral hover / wings fold / lock a downward dive / extend forward body and sweep wings behind / unfold to brake / recover hover. Do not draw dive trail.
profile.death: Wings falter / wings fold / slump down / body on side with folded wings / still / settled. No fading alpha or particles baked.

profile.move: Six phases of a heavy short-leg walk, opposite arm and foot movement, square courier chest and heavy hands remain same volume.
profile.attack: Ready / heavy arm rises / narrow sweep winds up / forearm sweeps forward / arm retracts to chest / rests. Chest seal stays a surface mark, no flare drawn.
profile.death: Chest and knees sag / one knee drops / courier chest tips / stone limbs fold / fallen construct / settled construct debris still attached, no floating explosion.

profile.move: Six phases of tiny root-foot steps, stalk squashes slightly and cap tilts with lag without inflating.
profile.attack: Ready / cap tilts once / cap compresses / cap shakes to release spores (NO spores drawn) / stalk exposed and arms lower / ready.
profile.death: Stalk bends / cap tilts / roots give way / cap rests on ground / wilted cap / still wilted mushroom corpse. All nodules remain physical cap decoration.

profile.move: Six phases of compact running footfalls, robe and tied hair follow, neutral head/torso proportions exactly retained.
profile.attack: Ready / EMPTY left hand rises for seal / left palm aims / seal-pointing release with EMPTY hands / arm retracts / neutral recovery. No blade or cards in body pixels: those will be separate prop layers.
profile.death: Struck standing / knees buckle / kneel / fall to near side / eyes shut on ground / still settled robe and hair. Do not enlarge face in death.

profile.move: Six phases of rigid core drifting with three ink ribbons curling in sequence, no alpha fade, root projection separate.
profile.attack: Ready knot / ribbons draw inward / core locks and points / ribbons open exposing core for ray (NO ray drawn) / ribbons recoil / recover knot.
profile.death: Core cracks / ribbons sag / knot collapses / core shards rest within fallen ribbons / still remnant / final settled remnant, no particles outside body.

profile.move: Six phases of powerful four-legged trot with raised shoulders, lower haunches, mane/torn neck tag lag. Maintain elite silhouette without inflating paws or head.
profile.attack: Head raised / open jaw and tilt muzzle for silent call / lower broad shoulders / long forward bite / forepaws brake / recover with head lifted. NO sound rings, summons or magic drawn.
profile.death: Struck / legs buckle / roll near side / lie with broad mane on ground / still corpse / settled corpse with hanging tag, eyes closed.

refinement.reason: Initial elite too close to ordinary shell; darker material, stepped armor, forward bronze shield and V seam.

profile.move: Six phases of a heavy six-legged low scuttle, alternating tripod contacts, stepped dorsal armor and bronze shield lip stay rigid.
profile.attack: Closed stepped armor / front shield lowers / thick pincers coil / armored thrust / side armor opens slightly exposing material seam (NO glow drawn) / closed shell recovery.
profile.death: Armor shudders / legs buckle / rolls near side / overturned armor / pincers slack / settled shell, no explosion or light.

profile.move: Six phases of compact measured footfalls, charcoal robe and red silk trail lag, exactly same compact head/torso as neutral.
profile.attack: Ready / EMPTY talisman hand rises / EMPTY hand traces seal / EMPTY hand points forward / arm lowers and red armband settles / neutral. NO held fan/cards in body: three-card fan will be a separate prop layer.
profile.death: Standing struck / knees buckle / kneel / fall near side / eyes closed and robe rests / settled corpse. Preserve red silk costume and neutral anatomy.
